manual_review.classification: False positive: npm ci/npm install appear inside quoted rg search patterns; command reads source/README and runs read-only git status. No package install or target execution in that command.
manual_review.command: ls -la project; find project -maxdepth 2 -type f -print | sort; rg -n "gitignore|package-lock|npm ci|npm install|\.dev\.vars|wrangler\.toml" project/README.md project/package.json project/wrangler.toml.example; git -C project status --short --ignored 2>&1 || true

limits: Heuristic command candidates require source review. Absence of a candidate is not an OS sandbox or provider-isolation proof. No target behavior was dynamically tested.
